endorsements.quote: In our case study, system logs should capture information such as AI decisions, confidence scores, model versions, scanning configurations, timestamps, user actions and overrides, misses and near misses, and clinician notes.
In our case study, each interaction (confirming or overriding the AI output, flagging unusual cases, correcting heatmaps) should be recorded.

A more practical approach is to align oversight intensity with the system's intended level of autonomy, using safeguards that support selective escalation of uncertain cases rather than manual review of all outputs.

In our case study, in addition to a conservative rule-out pathway that sends uncertain inputs to manual review, the platform must also allow users to override AI decisions and route cases to radiologists.
After software or model updates, the site should also verify the deployed model version and document basic checks showing that triage outputs remain consistent under the local MRI protocol.
In our case study, radiology teams should preserve evidence (MRI scans, AI outputs, heatmaps), document clinical impact (missed or delayed csPCa), and avoid local fixes during the investigation.

unlisted_practices: Regulators and standard-setting bodies should provide operational guidance on human oversight of clinical AI, including minimum oversight actions, escalation thresholds, documentation expectations, and division of responsibilities between healthcare providers and manufacturers, aligned across the AIA and MDR.
Integrate AI oversight, documentation, and escalation pathways into existing quality and patient safety routines rather than treating them as standalone regulatory work.
Monitor AI-triaged rule-out cases by randomly sampling a fixed proportion for radiologist review rather than reading all triaged cases.
Flag cases with missing, corrupted, or artifact-affected input sequences and route them to manual review instead of relying on AI triage output.
Record structured fields in RIS or PACS, such as the AI output, whether it was overridden, and a brief reason, to create a light evidence trail.
Extend regulatory sandboxes into the post-market phase to support safe and efficient AI system updates, including healthcare-specific sandboxes.
